row.name: Kids and Tots Unlimited Too Learning Center and Day Care

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: Criteria for extreme weather was not in operational policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The television was showing a movie during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 3 out of 10 children were missing immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: 1 of 8 children did not have a signature on file from the doctor or physician that he is cleared to come to daycare. Child was enrolled 06/02/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: In the girls restroom under the sink in cabinet their was a disinfectant cleaner that states "keep out of reach of children".     This was corrected at inspection when center removed product from restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: One TV in classroom was on shelf and was not anchored or bolted down.    This was corrected at inspection when director removed from classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: 8 of 8 children did not have statement of special needs on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The center was missing policy on transportation, promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity,preventing and responding to abuse neglect and procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: The booster seat that was being used expired in 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed: The booster seat was not the appropriate booster seat for the 3 year old child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §746.5607(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One caregiver's CPR/First Aid certification was expired (03/2023).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver only had 6 hours of the 24 annual training hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The operation did not have an employee list posted.    This was corrected during inspection by director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Children's sleeping cots were not labeled.    This was corrected during inspection by caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored: The carport used as shading in the play ground had 12 bolts that were protruding. The bolts needed tightening to help prevent trips, cuts, or any other potential injuries from the protruding bolts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Securely Anchored (26 TAC §746.4601(5))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Fire extinguishers were last service in 03/2022 and were due for servicing by 03/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The Child Product Form was observed to be expired (2/16/22).    This was corrected during inspection by office manager.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The tricycles in the playground area had broken seats and did not have the rubber stopper on the handles. The two picnic tables in the playground had loose boards and were extremely wobbly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: Two out of ten children's records needed the doctor signed health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The menu posted stated the center was going to serve chicken taco, but they served ground beef with beans.    Corrected at inspection: The center updated the menu during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Space Requirements for School-age - Individual Activities: The school age children were observed napping on the floor with no nap equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Space Requirements for School-age - Individual Activities (26 TAC §746.2703(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four out of ten children's records reviewed were lacking an address for the emergency contact.     Corrected at inspection: The center filled in the emergency contact address during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Three out of ten children's records were lackin the date of admission.     Corrected at inspection: The center filled in the date of admission during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended: A child was left unattended in the transportation van by two separate caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - No Child Unattended (26 TAC §746.5605(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: A caregiver was neglectful by failing to ensure all children had exited the transportation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The center did not inform a parent that their child was left completely unattended in a transportation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Curbside: A caregiver allowed children to run across a parking lot when they were unloaded from the transportation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Curbside (26 TAC §746.5605(1))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The center did not fill out an incident report for the child that was left unattended in a transportation van.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: One out of ten children's files reviewed was lacking the school information and three out of ten were lacking the school adress. One file was lacking the school phone number.     Corrected at inspection: The children's files were updated during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of ten children's files reviewed did not have  an emergency contact. Four out of ten children's files were lacking the address for the emergency contact.    Corrected at inspection: The emergency contacts were updated during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Two out of ten children's files were lacking an immunization on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: A person with an ineligilble status was observed in a classroom caring for children.    Corrected at Inspection: Person was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Three out of ten children's files were missing the date of admission.     Corrected at inspection: The date of admissions were added during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))
